stock.description: Kam Hing International Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and global distribution of knitted fabrics and dyed yarns. Its extensive market presence reaches across Mainland China, Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, and various other international regions. The company organizes its diverse operations into three main segments: Fabric, Garment, and a broad "Others" category. In addition to its core fabric business, it actively produces and trades garment products. The company's service offerings are broad, encompassing wastewater treatment, air and ocean freight handling, subcontracting, and professional corporate services such as management, sales strategy development, and consulting. Furthermore, Kam Hing engages in the commercial exchange of yarns, dyeing materials, and finished fabrics, while also holding properties and conducting mining activities. Established in 1996, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.
